decisionProcess.demandMechanism: Institutional lodging and small-to-medium meeting/catering requirements generated by visiting faculty, researchers, exchange participants, external specialists and university delegations.
decisionProcess.summary: Sourcing accessibility is partially evidenced. UQROO has a formal Dirección General de Administración y Finanzas / Recursos Materiales / Área de Adquisiciones structure, publishes procurement requirements and runs public lodging procedures.
